list.name: patient
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM alert_episodes ORDER BY patient_id

panels.title: Seizures — Last 14 Days
panels.description: Headline count for the current period, so the % change beside it has context.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM alert_episodes WHERE family='SEIZURE' AND patient_id = '$patient' AND start_time > NOW() - INTERVAL 14 DAY

panels.title: Weekly Trend
panels.description: Change in seizure count per week, fitted across every week of data (not just a two-point comparison, which is too noisy with this few episodes per week). Negative = improving, positive = worsening.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (COUNT(*)*SUM(w*c) - SUM(w)*SUM(c)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*)*SUM(w*w) - POWER(SUM(w),2), 0) AS value FROM (SELECT FLOOR(DATEDIFF(start_time, (SELECT MIN(start_time) FROM alert_episodes WHERE family='SEIZURE' AND patient_id='$patient')) / 7) AS w, COUNT(*) AS c FROM alert_episodes WHERE family='SEIZURE' AND $__timeFilter(start_time) AND patient_id = '$patient' GROUP BY w) t

panels.title: Treatment Response Rate
panels.description: Of the seizures severe enough to matter, what fraction actually got a therapy response from the implant?

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM surge_evaluations s WHERE s.patient_id=e.patient_id AND s.epoch_id=e.epoch_id AND s.stim_active=1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM alert_episodes e WHERE e.family='SEIZURE' AND e.severity='critical' AND $__timeFilter(e.start_time) AND e.patient_id = '$patient'

panels.title: Seizures per Week — $patient
panels.description: Is this patient's seizure frequency going up, down, or flat over time? Red = confirmed seizure, orange = milder/brief event.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(start_time, '7d'), severity AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM alert_episodes WHERE family='SEIZURE' AND $__timeFilter(start_time) AND patient_id = '$patient' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Average Seizure Length per Week — $patient
panels.description: Are seizures getting shorter (treatment working) or longer (treatment failing)?

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(start_time, '7d'), patient_id AS metric, AVG(duration_ms) AS value FROM alert_episodes WHERE family='SEIZURE' AND $__timeFilter(start_time) AND patient_id = '$patient' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Average Seizure Intensity per Week — $patient
panels.description: Are seizures getting milder or more severe over time? (kept as its own chart rather than overlaid on length, since the two are different scales)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(start_time, '7d'), patient_id AS metric, AVG(peak_surge_index) AS value FROM alert_episodes WHERE family='SEIZURE' AND $__timeFilter(start_time) AND patient_id = '$patient' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Where This Patient's Seizures Start — $patient
panels.description: Which part of the brain do this patient's seizures originate from — is it consistent or shifting?

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.anatomical_location AS onset, COUNT(*) AS n_episodes FROM alert_episodes e JOIN channels c ON c.channel_id = e.onset_channel WHERE e.family='SEIZURE' AND $__timeFilter(e.start_time) AND e.patient_id = '$patient' GROUP BY onset ORDER BY n_episodes DESC
